summary: Tested Phase 1 backend improvements: blocked_times CRUD, statistics aggregation, availability with blocks, plus verified frontend ThemeContext + CSS variables + new dependencies.
passed: GET /api/ health returns 200 with expected message
POST /api/barbers/{barber_id}/blocked-times creates block (200) with block_id, date, start_time, end_time, reason
GET /api/public/{org_id}/availability correctly excludes 14:00/14:30/15:00/15:30 when block 14:00-16:00 exists (200)
GET /api/statistics?start_date=...&end_date=... returns total_revenue, total_appointments, daily_stats[], service_stats[], barber_stats[] (200)
DELETE /api/barbers/{barber_id}/blocked-times/{block_id} removes block (200); subsequent GET returns []
Frontend index.css defines CSS variables for :root (light) and .dark (dark mode)
action_items: Proceed to Phase 2: implement visual UI components (Recharts dashboards, QR buttons, improved clients page, theme toggle in header) that consume these APIs
Note: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing — test sessions were injected directly into MongoDB for auth. Consider documenting test credentials for future iterations.
